mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, increasing equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in all periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A labor market overheating condition (UNRATE > 5.5%) signals an impending recession that depresses corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a sharp contraction in consumer demand and manufacturing output, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and INDPRO both decline in the past month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO < 115), a decline in industrial production signals weak output growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 115, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index above 190 (indicating elevated inflation) triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in a potential Fed response.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 190, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 2000 thousand units signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 2000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% and decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 132000 signals a deteriorating labor market, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0 and PAYEMS < 132000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 115 combined with a contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) below 10900 billion dollars signals a recession, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 115 and GDPC1 < 10900, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
